messages:
maya: noticing allocator health in us-west1-b (az1b) — GPU churn up 2.3x last 10m, preemptions + network retries. Rolling tenant pressure visible on p99 latency. @ops-jen any ongoing jobs?
ops-jen: seeing same, flame graph shows kube-scheduler backlog, kubelet OOMs on 3 nodes. opened k8s node incident: https://internal/issue/1234
liam: can we shift noncritical tenants to burst pool in other AZs? what's capacity in az1a/az1c?
infra-ash: az1a has spare g4x16 capacity ~120 vGPUs, az1c low. We can spin reserved burst in 5-10m, but provisioning will cause temporary placement failures.
maya: plan: - mark 3 worst nodes cordoned, - migrate long-running low-priority jobs to burst in az1a, - leave high-SLA tenants pinned. Will coordinate on canaries.
samir: +1. Add a traffic-split at the router level for 10% to az1a initially. We'll monitor error-rate and RLQ. @deploy-bot can you create a canary route?
deploy-bot: created route canary-usw2-az1a -> weight 10%. Rolling update id: r-7843. Will auto-scale if CPU > 70% for 2m.
maya: kubectl drain node/worker-az1b-12 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --force  # starting
ops-jen: watch logs: `kubectl get pods -o wide --all-namespaces | grep Evicted` — most low-priority jobs are requeued as expected.
infra-ash: note: prefix cache warm will drop. We'll pre-warm common models on burst nodes: ansible playbook run `ansible-playbook prewarm.yml -l az1a-burst`
liam: cost note — burst has spot pricing, keep alert if average token cost jumps >5% in 30m. Send to #finance-alerts if so.
maya: deployed canary, shifting 10% traffic. p50 latency +30ms, p99 +110ms in az1a initially (cache cold).
samir: observing increase in retry 502s from a subset of tenants — lowering to 5% while cache warms.
maya: lowering canary weight to 5% and re-running prewarm. continuing node drains. will post update in 10m. :hourglass:
ops-jen: added runbook note: if p99 remains >200ms for 20m, rollback route to 0% and reattach pods to pinned nodes.
maya: thanks — will escalate if any tenant hits error budget. keeping this thread as source of truth.
